trigger: Strand at the bridge command post, two radios on the table.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Two radios. One says GOVERNOR. One says IRONWOOD. Both are talking to her.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: Saint Paul says stand down and protect citizens. Kessler says assist or be relieved.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: Both are legal. I checked. I have a law degree's worth of checking now.

choices.text: You told me 41 days. Who's eating?

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: ...Nobody. Not here. The grain goes east and we're at day nine of forty-one.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: Okay. Okay. I took an oath to Minnesota first.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: You've never used my first name. ...You're right. You're right.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She keys the Guard net. 'All Northland units, this is Strand. Disengage from Ironwood. Protect civilians.'

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: Kessler will call that mutiny. He might be right. Go, Dell. Do something with it.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: Thank you. That's... easier. God help me, it's easier.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She switches off the governor's radio. Then she sits very still.

nodes.speaker: strand
nodes.text: No. It's mine. That's the problem.
